crossRefs.note: Caleb said, “He who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it, to him I will give Achsah my daughter as wife.”
Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.
The men of Israel said, “Have you seen this man who has come up? He has surely come up to defy Israel. The king will…
The three sons of Zeruiah were there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel: and Asahel was as light of foot as a wild gazelle.
When Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside into the middle of the gate to speak with him quietly, and…
Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder,
Now Joab was over all the army of Israel, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites,

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jebusites
people.line: Canaanite tribe inhabiting Jerusalem before David's conquest

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

people.name: Zeruiah
people.line: Sister of David; mother of Joab, Abishai, and Asahel

translations.web: David said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.
translations.bsb: Now David had said, “Whoever is the first to strike down a Jebusite will become chief commander.” And Joab son of Zeruiah went up first, and he became the chief.
translations.kjv: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went ➔ first up, and was chief.
translations.asv: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. And Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.
